purpose: Implementation opportunities for the new analyst pack; not a promise that every selector is implemented or approved.

readOnlyAudit.publicationFinding: Final scores can be cached before publication. Unpublished games are excluded from public result and performance facts.
readOnlyAudit.scope: One inspected native runtime snapshot; every future capture still requires coverage and validity checks.

statusLegend.calculated: Implemented structured measure; authored runtime wording remains disabled.
statusLegend.partly-calculated: Some measures implemented; listed extensions need work.
statusLegend.captured-validated: Fields captured and reconciled; selector still to implement.
statusLegend.derivable: Available captured facts support a planned calculation; selector still to implement.
statusLegend.partly-derivable: Some facts exist; specific joins/semantics need validation.
statusLegend.structured-facts: Existing event data supports the family; new editorial selection may still be needed.
statusLegend.schema-discovered: Local schema confirms fields; capture, semantics and calculation are not yet validated for this use.
statusLegend.existing-fictional-model: Fictional generated data, never native or real sportsbook data.

opportunities.evidence: Rushing yards/game and full-field rank are available. Add yards/carry and attempts/game to separate workload from efficiency.
opportunities.whyInteresting: A top rushing total may come from volume, not unusually productive carries.
opportunities.remaining: Yards/carry extension still needs projected counter reconciliation; never call it success rate.

opportunities.evidence: Weighted season conversion rate with actual sample and attempts.
opportunities.whyInteresting: An impressive record can hide repeated difficulty extending drives.
opportunities.remaining: Zero attempts is unavailable; do not average individual game percentages or infer distance-to-go.

opportunities.evidence: Trips and touchdowns reconcile across game caches and season totals for all 138 teams in the inspected capture.
opportunities.whyInteresting: A productive offense may repeatedly settle for less than six.
opportunities.remaining: Do not call all non-TD trips field goals. Project and validate OFFREDZONEFGS separately for that breakdown.

opportunities.evidence: Takeaways, giveaways and net margin retain games played.
opportunities.whyInteresting: A team can be winning with a cushion that may not persist.
opportunities.remaining: Describe future implications conditionally; raw turnover margin is not a luck estimate.

opportunities.evidence: Observed ranking movement can join player production from the correct published game.
opportunities.whyInteresting: Explain why a candidate is interesting rather than just listing names.
opportunities.remaining: School context required; no claim about the reason voters changed their minds.

opportunities.evidence: Quarter scores plus overtime sum to final scores in all 511 inspected published finals.
opportunities.calculation: Q4 points for - Q4 points against; cumulative Q1–Q3 lead
opportunities.whyInteresting: Find teams repeatedly finishing strongly, or losing after leading through three.
opportunities.remaining: Compute selectors and tests next. Quarter-end scores cannot reveal the largest in-game deficit or when a lead changed.

opportunities.evidence: Published quarter-score splits can establish halftime and final score state.
opportunities.whyInteresting: Give a comeback story an actual measured basis.
opportunities.remaining: Not implemented as a selector yet. Distinguish halftime deficit from biggest deficit; separate overtime wins.

opportunities.evidence: Published final scores and current-season result coverage corroborated for all 138 teams.
opportunities.calculation: record in games decided by <= 8; mean final point differential
opportunities.whyInteresting: Reveal a contender living on narrow wins or a losing team staying competitive.
opportunities.remaining: An eight-point boundary is an editorial one-possession convention, not an arbitrary milestone. Do not imply play-by-play win probability.

opportunities.evidence: Unique largest winning margin is computed from full current-season results with tie suppression.
opportunities.whyInteresting: Identify a real outlier without baking in a fixed example such as 42 points.
opportunities.remaining: Current-season claims only. Cross-season streaks need validated historical continuity and ordering.

opportunities.evidence: Published game-level team stats are already accessible.
opportunities.calculation: last 3 completed games versus all earlier completed games
opportunities.whyInteresting: A team can be improving or declining beneath an unchanged season average.
opportunities.remaining: Require complete samples, label windows, and avoid automatic tactical or opponent-adjustment claims.

opportunities.evidence: TeamStats contains passing/rushing yards allowed, sacks and offensive attempts.
opportunities.calculation: own rush yards/carry versus opponent rush yards allowed/carry
opportunities.whyInteresting: Preview an actual strength against a weakness.
opportunities.remaining: Extend projection and reconcile denominator semantics first; no EPA, pressure rate or success rate from box scores.

opportunities.evidence: TeamStats includes SACKS and SACKSALLOWED; player defensive game stats already exist.
opportunities.whyInteresting: Highlight a meaningful pressure-point matchup or a multi-game change.
opportunities.remaining: Validate aggregation and half-sack semantics. Sacks are not total pressures.

opportunities.evidence: TeamStats includes PENALTIES, PENALTYYARDS and POSSESSIONTIME.
opportunities.whyInteresting: A useful under-the-radar team tendency beyond yards and rankings.
opportunities.remaining: Verify possession units and cache semantics. Do not infer discipline or coaching cause as a measured fact.

opportunities.evidence: Player SeasonStats/CareerStats and SchoolYear are present; recent game production is already captured.
opportunities.calculation: player share of team receiving/rushing yards; class-year share
opportunities.whyInteresting: Reveal a breakout contributor or an offense leaning heavily on one player.
opportunities.remaining: Extend full season player-stat mapping and reconcile team totals; distinguish receiving yards from all-purpose yards.

opportunities.family: Opponent quality, venue and schedule context
opportunities.evidence: Published results identify opponents; schema has stadium and schedule venue context.
opportunities.calculation: opponent records excluding head-to-head; home/road splits
opportunities.whyInteresting: Compare records with the schedule actually faced.
opportunities.remaining: Neutral-site semantics and generic FCS identity must be resolved before venue/schedule-strength claims. Current opponent rank is not kickoff rank.

opportunities.evidence: Awards exposes WeeklyAwards and AnnualAwards; league history exposes award and stat-record records.
opportunities.calculation: award holder changes; verified historical record comparison
opportunities.whyInteresting: Surface accomplishments the user might miss elsewhere.
opportunities.remaining: Resolve award enums, player references and historical scope. Never label a season best a school record without actual history.

opportunities.evidence: Actual offers/commitments, positions, national ranks and coach identity are captured. Native class ranks are schema-visible.
opportunities.calculation: new commitments by position; verified class-rank movement
opportunities.whyInteresting: Explain what a commitment means for the class, beyond repeating the announcement.
opportunities.remaining: Persist prior class snapshots and validate class ranking fields. Do not expose hidden influence or imply promises.

opportunities.evidence: Injury changes and later published-game participation are available.
opportunities.calculation: injury state transition + verified subsequent performance
opportunities.whyInteresting: Follow a real return or a meaningful absence in weekly context.
opportunities.remaining: A cleared flag alone is not evidence of participation; no invented medical timeline or diagnosis.

opportunities.evidence: Existing model-generated lines can be labeled and persisted as fictional Dynasty content.
opportunities.calculation: published result versus archived pregame line
opportunities.whyInteresting: Let fans and analysts revisit an actual prior in-world expectation.
opportunities.remaining: Never reconstruct a supposedly pregame line from the final result. No claim of a real sportsbook source.

excludedClaims: Numerical player ability values or hidden transfer probability as public news
EPA, success rate, pressure rate or play-level explanations inferred from final box scores
National or historical superlatives from partial coverage
